body_excerpt: ## What's Changed * Encode the profile's creation_date_time instead of the current time by @virtualritz in https://github.com/awxkee/moxcms/pull/195 * Fix swapped CICP colour primaries in P3 default profiles by @virtualritz in https://github.com/awxkee/moxcms/pull/194 * Round integer gamma table entries to nearest by @son653 in https://github.com/awxkee/moxcms/pull/196 * Fix TRC tag size overflow on 32-bit targets by @Mrmaxmeier in https://github.com/awxkee/moxcms/pull/197 * Use Q1.30 on NEON only when the matrix fits in it by @priard in https://github.com/awxkee/moxcms/pull/203 * Fall back to `A2B0`/`B2A0` when the rendering intent's LUT tag is missing by @mertalev in https://github.com/awxkee/moxcms/pull/205 * Fix `BarycentricWeightScale::High` above 8 bits and index it by sample by @mertalev in https://github.com/awxkee/moxcms/pull/204 * fix(icc): align encoded profile tag data by @jay23606 in https://github.com/awxkee/moxcms/pull/206 * Better tag writing, reducing
